parameters.value: A digital, PC-based system for performing electrodiagnostic studies, including Electromyography (EMG), Nerve Conduction Studies (NCS/NCV), and Evoked Potentials (EP).
To aid in the diagnosis, evaluation, and monitoring of disorders of the peripheral and central nervous systems, including nerves, muscles, and neuromuscular junctions.
Constant Current / Constant Voltage with adjustable duration and intensity.
Brainstem Auditory Evoked Potentials (BAEP/ABR), Visual Evoked Potentials (VEP), and Somatosensory Evoked Potentials (SSEP).

Starter set of all necessary electrodes and accessories, including: Bar electrode, Ring electrodes, Ground strap, Disposable concentric needle electrodes, Reusable surface disc electrodes, and all required connecting cables.
